title: Cosmic Mirror Portal
description: A woman in a sparkling silver sequined bikini and purple headscarf stands in an ornate oval mirror framed with glowing turquoise and purple crystals. She smiles while taking a selfie as the mirror reveals a swirling cosmic portal filled with galaxies, nebulae, and floating crystals that spills into a cozy bedroom with pink satin bedding and string lights.
prompt: A beautiful woman wearing a sparkling silver sequined bikini and a sheer purple headscarf stands inside an ornate oval mirror decorated with glowing turquoise and purple crystals. She smiles while taking a selfie with her phone. The mirror acts as a portal into a swirling cosmic vortex of galaxies, stars, and floating crystals that merges with a cozy feminine bedroom featuring pink satin sheets, string lights, and a bedside table with a drink.
